items.author: saffroncr.bsky.social
items.context:
I built my dream retro 2000s PC, and I'm thinking of playing some games on it this weekend… for research for my metroidbrainia game, of course 😅 Thinking of playing a bit of Thief 2, System Shock 2, Deus Ex, Arx Fatalis... Any other recommendations?
2 images: ASUS P5KPL-AM Intel Core 2 Duo E7500 2.93 GHz 2GB RAM (2x Kingston KVR800D2N6/1G DDR2) GeForce 8800GT Sound Blaster Audigy 2 1TB Western Digital Caviar Black / Retro PC playing Oblivion
items.text: That list is a great start. Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines fits right in with it, same era and the same "solve it your way" feel. If you try it, install the community patch first.

items.author: denyally.bsky.social
items.context: Rollback, Steam Deck support, and it's still free? Brief Karate Foolish really woke up and chose violence.
items.text: Free and Deck-ready is a hard combo to beat. Rollback netcode is also what makes online fighting games feel smooth, so that's a real upgrade.
